name: Oil and lubricants
summary: Motor oil, gear oil, hydraulic fluid, grease and spray lubricants that keep machines running.
identify: Auto parts stores, garages, farm sheds, marine and garden shops, and workshops. Machines carry their own: engine sumps, gearboxes, hydraulic tanks and compressor crankcases can be drained.
test: Rub a drop between your fingers: it should feel slick, not gritty. Milky oil has water in it; black, burnt-smelling oil is worn out but still fine for chains and rust-proofing.

decay.note: Sealed oil keeps for years. Open containers pick up water.
